title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a handwritten note. It is a typed page, scanned upside down, from the typescript of SGA 7, Exposé IX ('Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), page IX-112, section 9.4. It carries the archival stamp 430 and has been filed among the handwritten notes on divided-power de Rham complexes. Its content does not continue the neighbouring pages, which concern hyperalgebras and comodules.

Setting: S is a trait (a DVR spectrum) with generic point η and special point s. There are coefficient data P, Q, R. E and F are extensions forming the outer pieces of a three-step filtration. A 'mixed extension' (extension panachée, SGA 7 VII/IX) X of E by F is an object with such a filtration whose graded pieces are given.

First paragraph: S is strictly local. The vanishing Ext^2(Q,P)=0 lets one apply the general construction of 9.3.13 to Y' = X_η, a given mixed extension of E_η by F_η. This yields a canonical element c(X_η). Formula 9.4.5 identifies c(X_η) with an element of Q̌_o ⊗ Q̌*_o, which makes the pairing (9.4.2) precise. By 9.3, c(X_η) is exactly the obstruction to extending X_η to a mixed extension X over S.

9.4.6: for S henselian, the definition is obtained by Galois descent from the strict henselisation.

Proposition 9.4.7: S is now an arbitrary trait. Restriction X ↦ X_η is fully faithful from mixed extensions over S to mixed extensions over η. A generic X_η lies in the essential image iff the induced pairing c_o(X_η): Q_o ⊗ Q*_o → Λ_s vanishes. This pairing is computed on the henselisation S^h. In words: a mixed extension extends over the trait iff its monodromy obstruction pairing is zero.

This is the abstract mechanism behind Grothendieck's monodromy pairing for Néron models. Elsewhere in Exposé IX, the obstruction to extending the generic biextension of A_η × A'_η by G_m to the Néron models is read off from a monodromy pairing.
errors: No mathematical errors are visible. The typescript presupposes 9.3.13, 9.4.1, 9.4.2 and 9.4.5, which are not on this page.
The page is misfiled: a printed/typed SGA 7 page among handwritten notes on divided-power de Rham complexes.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typescript page of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX (Prop. 9.4.7), merely misfiled and scanned upside down in this folder. Nothing on it is unpublished.
transcription_corrections: The image is rotated 180°. It is a typed page (SGA 7, IX-112) with archival stamp '430', not a handwritten note.
The faint pencil annotation at the top edge (upside down) appears to read something like '9.4 ⟶ ...'. It is not captured in the transcription.
The element space in the first paragraph is typed as Q̌_o ⊗ Q̌*_o (checks over Q_o and Q*_o). In (9.4.7.2) the pairing is c_o(X_η): Q_o ⊗ Q*_o → Λ_s, without checks.
The handwritten '155' in the corner is the archive page number.
